# BigQuery convex hull outputs, including degenerate and spherical cases.

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 0)'))
=> "POINT(0 0)"

# The documentation example returns POINT(0.999999999999943 1), but BigQuery returned
# POINT(1 1) when these observations were collected. Preserve this difference for rechecking
# if BigQuery changes its behavior: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions#st_convexhull
SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 1)'))
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(179 80)'))
=> "POINT(179 80)"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 10 0)'))
=> "LINESTRING(10 0, 5 0, 0 0)"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 5 0, 10 0)'))
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 5 0, 10 0)"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 2)'))
=> "LINESTRING(2 2, 1.49988573656168 1.5000570914792, 1 1)"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(2 11, 4 12, 0 15, 1 9, 1 12)'))
=> "POLYGON((1 9, 4 12, 0 15, 1 9))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 90 0, 180 0)'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 120 0, -120 0)'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 180 0)'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(10 20, -170 -20)'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 80, 120 80, -120 80)'))
=> "POLYGON((-120 80, 0 80, 120 80, -120 80))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(170 10, -170 10, 180 20)'))
=> "POLYGON((170 10, -170 10, 180 20, 170 10))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(-80 -70, 80 -70, 80 70, -80 70)'))
=> "POLYGON((-80 -70, 80 -70, 80 70, -80 70, -80 -70))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'))
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 10, 0 0), (2 2, 2 3, 3 3, 2 2))'))
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 10, 0 0))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(20 20), LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0), POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0)))'))
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 10 0, 20 20, 0 1, 0 0))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

# BigQuery geography function documentation: NULL propagates.

SELECT ST_CONVEXHULL(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null
